sloka: सो ऽपश्यन्नन्दिनं तत्र देवस्यादूरतः स्थितम् ।दीप्तं शूलमवष्टभ्य द्वितीयमिव शङ्करम् ।। ७.१६.१३ ॥
transliteration: so 'paśyannandinaṁ tatra devasyādūrataḥ sthitam ।dīptaṁ śūlamavaṣṭabhya dvitīyamiva śaṅkaram ।। 7.16.13 ॥

translations.english: There, not far from Shiva, he saw Nandi standing, firmly holding a shining trident, appearing like a second Shankara himself.
